doc.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01

title: Basic chords for rhythm playing and chord sequences in different keys
summary: Allen asks which chords matter most; Marrero explains relying on the ear, playing the blues in C, moving shapes up the neck, and chord progressions in several keys.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
